Ordinary Council Meeting - Monday, 26 October, 2026
An Ordinary meeting of the Latrobe Council will be held at the Council Chambers, Latrobe on Monday 26 October, 2026 commencing at 5.00pm.
The agenda will be available for perusal on Latrobe Council’s website prior to the meeting.
Public Attendance at Council Meetings
Council meetings are currently open to public attendance, however attendance limits may still be considered due to Council’s Workplace Health & Safety obligations. It is recommended that members of the public wishing to attend a Council meeting RSVP prior to each meeting by calling Council on 6426 4444.
Live Streaming Link
Council Meetings are live streamed for those who are unable to attend in person.
Click the below link to join the meeting via MS Teams:
26 October 2026 Latrobe Ordinary Council Meeting
Click the YouTube link below to view the latest live streamed meeting:
28 September 2026 Latrobe Council Ordinary Meeting YouTube Link
Council Minutes
The Local Government Act 1993 (Schedule 4 Paragraph 13) requires a Council's General Manager to record the minutes for every Council meeting.
The Act (Schedule 4 Paragraph 13 Sub-paragraph (2)) allows the General Manager to only record in the minutes that a matter was discussed in "closed" session and to not record details of the matter unless Council determines otherwise.
As soon as practicable but at least at the next ordinary meeting, minutes are to be circulated to all councillors and are to be confirmed as a true record at the next ordinary meeting by motion of a council or council committee.

Ordinary Council Meeting - Monday, 26 October, 2026
An Ordinary meeting of the Latrobe Council will be held at the Council Chambers, Latrobe on Monday 26 October, 2026 commencing at 5.00pm.
The agenda will be available for perusal on Latrobe Council’s website prior to the meeting.
Public Attendance at Council Meetings
Council meetings are currently open to public attendance, however attendance limits may still be considered due to Council’s Workplace Health & Safety obligations. It is recommended that members of the public wishing to attend a Council meeting RSVP prior to each meeting by calling Council on 6426 4444.
Live Streaming Link
Council Meetings are live streamed for those who are unable to attend in person.
Click the below link to join the meeting via MS Teams:
26 October 2026 Latrobe Ordinary Council Meeting
Click the YouTube link below to view the latest live streamed meeting:
28 September 2026 Latrobe Council Ordinary Meeting YouTube Link
Council Minutes
The Local Government Act 1993 (Schedule 4 Paragraph 13) requires a Council's General Manager to record the minutes for every Council meeting.
The Act (Schedule 4 Paragraph 13 Sub-paragraph (2)) allows the General Manager to only record in the minutes that a matter was discussed in "closed" session and to not record details of the matter unless Council determines otherwise.
As soon as practicable but at least at the next ordinary meeting, minutes are to be circulated to all councillors and are to be confirmed as a true record at the next ordinary meeting by motion of a council or council committee.
